resources.title: Rivals GREATEST MINDS Rank EVERY HERO In Season 8
resources.creator: Necros
resources.noteEs: Necros reúne a varios top players para rankear a cada hero del juego en la Season 8. Aprendes el porqué detrás del tier list, no solo el resultado.
resources.noteEn: Necros gathers several top players to rank every hero in Season 8. You get the reasoning behind the placements, not just the final tier list.

resources.title: NEW BEST and WORST Heroes in Marvel Rivals | Low & High Rank Season 8 Tier List
resources.creator: Coach_Mills
resources.noteEs: Tier list de la Season 8 que separa lo que funciona en low rank de lo que domina en high rank. Útil para elegir picks segun tu nivel actual.
resources.noteEn: A Season 8 tier list that splits what works in low rank from what dominates in high rank. Handy for choosing picks that match your current level.

resources.title: Flats OFFICIAL Marvel Rivals Season 8 Hero Tier List
resources.creator: Flats Two
resources.noteEs: Flats repasa hero por hero su tier list de la Season 8 con un enfoque de high elo. Buena referencia para entender el meta competitivo del parche actual.
resources.noteEn: Flats walks hero by hero through his Season 8 tier list from a high elo perspective. A solid reference for understanding the current competitive meta.

resources.title: TeamCaptains Marvel Rivals Season 8 Hero Tier List
resources.creator: TeamCaptain
resources.noteEs: Tier list condensado de la Season 8 que cubre los tres roles en poco mas de media hora. Buena opcion si quieres el ranking sin un video de varias horas.
resources.noteEn: A condensed Season 8 tier list covering all three roles in just over half an hour. A good pick if you want the rankings without a multi-hour video.

resources.title: Marvel Rivals Season 8 Team-Up Tier List | Best to Worst
resources.creator: PsychoSingh
resources.noteEs: En lugar de heroes sueltos, este video rankea los Team-Ups de la Season 8 de mejor a peor. Te ayuda a decidir que sinergias vale la pena armar en comp.
resources.noteEn: Instead of individual heroes, this video ranks the Season 8 Team-Ups from best to worst. It helps you decide which synergies are worth building in comp.
